name: Breath of Belladonna
description:
You consume a handful of belladonna berries. You take 1d4 damage from their poison, then exhale a poisonous cloud. Roll Spirit vs Fortitude against each creature within short range. On each win, the creature takes 3d10 damage. On a loss, half damage.

Describe how you exhale the cloud.
successes:
✨: Win or lose, each creature within short range checks a Condition.

🌞: Win or lose, each creature within short range takes 1d4 damage for the next 3 rounds.
